主要内容: On March 18, 2019, The Walt Disney Company announced the expiration and final results of the Exchange Offers and Consent Solicitations for 21CFA Notes. The Exchange Offers expired on March 15, 2019, with the condition that New Disney’s acquisition of 21CF must close. The Exchange Offers were for up to $18,128,740,000 in new notes and cash. The process was governed by documents dated October 5, 2018, and was subject to the closing of the acquisition. The results of the Exchange Offers and Consent Solicitations were finalized on March 18, 2019, following the expiration date.
